options.content:
# DORA Metrics (Jira-only) - nuam

**⚠️ Este dashboard usa Jira issues como proxy de deployments**.

### Definiciones aplicadas

| Métrica DORA | Definición en Jira |
|---|---|
| **Deployment Frequency** | Issues cerrados (`status=DONE`) con `type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'ERROR', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')` |
| **Lead Time for Changes** | Mediana de `lead_time_minutes` de issues cerrados tipo CAMBIO/TAREA/HISTORIA/MANTENCIÓN |
| **Change Failure Rate** | Issues `type=ERROR` cerrados / Total issues cerrados tipo cambio |
| **Failed Deployment Recovery Time** | Mediana de `lead_time_minutes` de issues `type=ERROR` cerrados |

### Fuente de datos
- Company-managed software Boards en Jira Proyectos

### Notas
- Los benchmarks DORA (elite/high/medium/low) son **orientativos** porque la fuente no son deployments reales sino tickets.
- Para DORA "oficial" se requiere conectar CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

panels.description: Resumen de las 4 métricas DORA calculadas desde Jira

targets.rawSql:
WITH _changes AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.lead_time_minutes
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_all_changes AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.type
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'ERROR', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_errors AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.lead_time_minutes
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type = 'ERROR'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_clt_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lead_time_minutes) - 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER () - 1, 0) AS ranks
  FROM _changes WHERE lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
),
_clt AS (
  SELECT MAX(lead_time_minutes) AS median_clt FROM _clt_ranks WHERE ranks <= 0.5
),
_mttr_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lead_time_minutes) - 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER () - 1, 0) AS ranks
  FROM _errors WHERE lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
),
_mttr AS (
  SELECT MAX(lead_time_minutes) AS median_mttr FROM _mttr_ranks WHERE ranks <= 0.5
),
_cfr AS (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS failures, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM _all_changes
),
_deploy_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS cnt FROM _all_changes
)
SELECT 'Deployment Frequency (last 12M)' AS metric, CONCAT(_deploy_count.cnt, ' deployments') AS value FROM _deploy_count
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lead Time for Changes (median)', CASE WHEN _clt.median_clt IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(_clt.median_clt / 60, 1), ' hours') END FROM _clt
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Change Failure Rate', CASE WHEN _cfr.total = 0 THEN 'N/A' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(_cfr.failures / _cfr.total * 100, 2), '% (', _cfr.failures, '/', _cfr.total, ')') END FROM _cfr
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Failed Deployment Recovery Time (median)', CASE WHEN _mttr.median_mttr IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(_mttr.median_mttr / 60, 1), ' hours') END FROM _mttr

panels.title: 📊 Overall DORA Metrics

targets.rawSql:
WITH _deployments AS (
  SELECT
    i.id,
    DATE_FORMAT(i.resolution_date, '%y/%m') AS month,
    DATE(i.resolution_date) AS day
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'ERROR', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_last_6_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT month
  FROM _deployments
  ORDER BY month DESC
  LIMIT 6
),
_monthly AS (
  SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS cnt
  FROM _deployments
  WHERE month IN (SELECT month FROM _last_6_months)
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(AVG(cnt), 1), ' deployments/month (avg last 6M)', CASE WHEN AVG(cnt) >= 30 THEN ' (elite)' WHEN AVG(cnt) >= 8 THEN ' (high)' WHEN AVG(cnt) >= 2 THEN ' (medium)' ELSE ' (low)' END) AS `Deployment Frequency`
FROM _monthly

WITH _changes AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.lead_time_minutes
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lead_time_minutes) - 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER () - 1, 0) AS ranks
  FROM _changes
),
_median AS (
  SELECT MAX(lead_time_minutes) AS median_clt FROM _ranks WHERE ranks <= 0.5
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN median_clt IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
    WHEN median_clt < 24 * 60 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(median_clt/60, 1), ' hours (elite)')
    WHEN median_clt < 7 * 24 * 60 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(median_clt/60, 1), ' hours (high)')
    WHEN median_clt < 30 * 24 * 60 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(median_clt/60, 1), ' hours (medium)')
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(median_clt/60, 1), ' hours (low)')
  END AS median_change_lead_time
FROM _median

WITH _all_changes AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.type
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'ERROR', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_cfr AS (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS failures, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM _all_changes
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN total = 0 THEN 'N/A'
    WHEN failures / total <= 0.05 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(failures/total*100, 2), '% (elite)')
    WHEN failures / total <= 0.10 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(failures/total*100, 2), '% (high)')
    WHEN failures / total <= 0.15 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(failures/total*100, 2), '% (medium)')
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(failures/total*100, 2), '% (low)')
  END AS change_failure_rate
FROM _cfr

WITH _errors AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.lead_time_minutes
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type = 'ERROR'
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lead_time_minutes) - 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER () - 1, 0) AS ranks
  FROM _errors
),
_median AS (
  SELECT MAX(lead_time_minutes) AS median_mttr FROM _ranks WHERE ranks <= 0.5
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN median_mttr IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
    WHEN median_mttr < 60 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(median_mttr/60, 1), ' hours (elite)')
    WHEN median_mttr < 24 * 60 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(median_mttr/60, 1), ' hours (high)')
    WHEN median_mttr < 7 * 24 * 60 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(median_mttr/60, 1), ' hours (medium)')
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(median_mttr/60, 1), ' hours (low)')
  END AS median_recovery_time
FROM _median

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(i.resolution_date, '%y/%m') AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS 'Deployment Count'
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
  AND i.status = 'DONE'
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'ERROR', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH _changes AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(i.resolution_date, '%y/%m') AS month,
    i.lead_time_minutes
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY lead_time_minutes) - 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY month) - 1, 0) AS ranks
  FROM _changes
),
_median AS (
  SELECT month, MAX(lead_time_minutes) AS median_clt
  FROM _ranks
  WHERE ranks <= 0.5
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(median_clt / 60, 2) AS 'Median Lead Time (hours)'
FROM _median
ORDER BY month

panels.title: ⏱️ Median Lead Time for Changes (by month)

targets.rawSql:
WITH _all_changes AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(i.resolution_date, '%y/%m') AS month,
    i.type
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type IN ('CAMBIO', 'TAREA', 'ERROR', 'HISTORIA', 'MANTENCIÓN')
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
)
SELECT
  month,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS 'Change Failure Rate'
FROM _all_changes
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH _errors AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(i.resolution_date, '%y/%m') AS month,
    i.lead_time_minutes
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (${board:sqlstring})
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.type = 'ERROR'
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
),
_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY lead_time_minutes) - 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY month) - 1, 0) AS ranks
  FROM _errors
),
_median AS (
  SELECT month, MAX(lead_time_minutes) AS median_mttr
  FROM _ranks
  WHERE ranks <= 0.5
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(median_mttr / 60, 2) AS 'Median Recovery Time (hours)'
FROM _median
ORDER BY month
